description:
Connect this project to a Chrome/Chromium the user started with --remote-debugging-port=

--user-data-dir=

(CAPTCHAs, logins); 127.0.0.1/localhost only. Refused unless this server runs with CDPILOT_MCP_ALLOW_CONNECT=1 (or the user runs `cdpilot connect`). Then every tool runs in that browser, with its cookies and logins, until browser_disconnect; cdpilot never closes it.

target.description: CDP port number, ws:// URL, or '--auto' to auto-detect.

name: browser_connect
